title: Kevin Jonas and the group perform at the NFL halftime show
seoTitle: Kevin Jonas and group perform at NFL halftime show
subtitle: The group performs at the first NFL regular season game in Australia after a twist with Joe's flight
excerpt: Kevin Jonas and his brothers perform the NFL halftime show in Australia after tense moments regarding Joe's arrival.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Kevin Jonas's name is trending on search engines due to the group's performance at the halftime show of the American football game between the San Francisco 49ers and the Los Angeles Rams. The event marks the first-ever NFL regular season game in Australia.

Joe's arrival and expectations for the show

The presence of the full trio on stage generated intense anticipation following unexpected travel issues for Joe Jonas. The singer was stranded in Dubai after missing his connecting flight due to delays on a previous flight departing from London. Kevin and Nick attended a fan event alone and showed an explanatory video to those present to reassure the public about their brother's situation.

The show at the Melbourne Cricket Ground

Despite the earlier scare, all three members managed to perform on the field of the Melbourne Cricket Ground for a crowd of 100,000 people. The group kicked off the performance with the hit Burnin’ Up and included tracks like Sucker and their most recent single Play This When Sad in the setlist.

Tributes and hits on the international stage

During the halftime show, the band also performed a version of Year 3000, a song that brought great commercial success to the group throughout their career. To win over the local crowd, the trio also performed a cover of the song You’re The Voice by Australian artist John Farnham.

The brothers' journey in music

Kevin Jonas is the oldest member of the band, accompanied by his brothers Joe and Nick. The group celebrates two decades of musical history since their official formation, accumulating major milestones in their career and expanding the group's presence to large-scale international sports venues.

With information from Bolavip US, Nine.com.au.
